description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify the names of Mayors & Chairmen of Local Authorities in Northern Province
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the Local Authorities (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012. It specifically details the results of local government elections in the Northern Province, listing the names of elected Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for various municipal councils, urban councils, and pradeshiya sabhas. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, election results, and declarations.
